questions.question: Which statement best describes External identity?

options.text: Protecting data while it moves across networks, commonly with protocols such as TLS

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure identity, access, and security
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure external identities
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: B2B collaboration: granting external users only the permissions they need for the intended collaboration.
B2B collaboration: inviting external partners or guests to access organizational resources using their own identities.
External identity: an identity belonging to a person outside the organization who needs controlled access to applications or resources.
Guest user: using one identity sign-in to access multiple trusted applications.
External identity: Microsoft Entra capabilities for managing access by external users and customers.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: External identity — an identity belonging to a person outside the organization who needs controlled access to applications or resources; and B2B collaboration — inviting external partners or guests to access organizational resources using their own identities.
